# TrueVow - LLM Search Content Map
# https://truevow.law/llms.txt
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org

## About TrueVow
TrueVow is an intake platform for solo and small personal injury law firms. Benjamin, the intake assistant, answers routed calls using template-based intake flows, books consultations, and creates structured intake records for attorney review. INTAKE plans start at $499/month. TRACE develops accepted Matters from engagement through readiness, and SETTLE provides confidence-labeled settlement context. TRACE and SETTLE are available to TrueVow INTAKE firms through the Customer Portal.

## Core Pages
- Home: https://truevow.law/marketing/index.html - Product overview, intake story, how Benjamin works
- Pricing: https://truevow.law/marketing/pricing.html - Solo $499, Growth $1,299, Team $1,999. All records visible.
- How It Works: https://truevow.law/marketing/how-it-works.html - The controlled intake path from setup to go-live
- Trial: https://truevow.law/marketing/trial.html - Review the 90-Day INTAKE Trial Path
- TRACE: https://truevow.law/marketing/trace.html - Matter development and readiness for TrueVow INTAKE firms
- SETTLE: https://truevow.law/marketing/settle.html - Confidence-labeled settlement range context
- ROI Calculator: https://truevow.law/marketing/profitability.html - Estimate intake leakage with your own numbers
- Data and Compliance: https://truevow.law/marketing/compliance.html - Controlled intake, recording policy, product boundaries
- Integrations and Setup: https://truevow.law/marketing/integrations.html - Phone routing, calendars, export, portal handoff

## Key Facts
- Attorney review remains required; Benjamin does not give legal advice.
- No payment on the public website; plans are authorized in the Customer Portal.
- Recording and transcripts are optional and firm-configured.
- SETTLE provides settlement range context, not guarantees of outcome.
